name: Obscura
summary: A light playful SaaS style with a cloud-blue canvas, Jersey 10 pixel headings, Manrope UI copy, one vivid orange CTA color, pixel cloud sprites, rounded app mockups, and soft blue-tinted shadows.

signalOrange.role: Primary CTA fill, hero emphasis, active nav, link hover, card accent

emberCrust.role: Footer background and rare dark brand block

cloudMist.role: Page canvas, card wash, secondary border, pixel-art fill

graphiteInk.role: Primary text, nav links, icon strokes, body copy

paperWhite.role: Card surface, app chrome, nav background

slatePencil.role: Secondary body text and muted icons

midnightInk.role: Strong text where orange needs contrast

components.primaryCta: Filled Signal Orange button, compact 6px radius, Manrope label, optional arrow icon.
components.secondaryButton: Transparent control with Cloud Mist border and Graphite Ink text.
components.hero: Centered stack on Cloud Mist with two-line Jersey headline, body copy, orange CTA, and cloud sprites.
components.featureCard: White card, 12px radius, 16px padding, Cloud Mist border, soft blue-tinted shadow, pixel illustration.
components.appWindowMockup: Rounded product window with traffic-light dots, sidebar, status pill, and soft shadow.
components.pixelCloudSprite: Flat 8-bit cloud graphic with 1px darker outline, used as divider and corner accent.
components.footer: Full-width Ember Crust band with white and warm-cream Manrope links.

dos: Use Jersey 10 for every display heading at 36px and above.
Keep one Signal Orange CTA fill per screen.
Use Cloud Mist as the full-page atmosphere.
Use pixel cloud sprites in corners and section gaps.
Keep Manrope for all readable UI copy.
donts: Do not use Jersey 10 for body text or nav labels.
Do not introduce a second brand color.
Do not make orange a full-page background.
Do not use smooth vector clouds.
Do not make the privacy product feel like a fortress.
